clue.text: Relax before conflict in plant

indicators.note: before places the first piece ahead of the second in the answer

parts.note: to loose is to slacken or relax a hold
strife is bitter conflict

explanation.surface: Advice to calm down before a fight breaks out among the plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Purple loosestrife is a tall waterside flowering species, so it is a kind of plant.

clue.text: Flowers to place in one's ear

indicators.note: something taken in through the ear is heard, so the word is judged by its sound

parts.note: to place something down is to lay it

explanation.surface: Someone tucks a blossom behind their ear.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hawaiian garland is woven from blossoms, so it is a ring of flowers.

clue.text: Maid of the Mountains with nothing to look at?

parts.note: O looks like a zero, nothing
to read a page is to look at it

explanation.surface: A mountain girl with no view, alluding to the operetta The Maid of the Mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth a mountain nymph is a spirit of the hills, a maiden of the peaks.

clue.text: Mouth opening here? What comes out could be true, say

indicators.note: what emerges from the words may be a different arrangement of their letters

explanation.surface: A dentist's chair: open wide, and whatever you say may be true.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What comes out could be' rearranges TRUE and SAY. The surface has a mouth opening to speak; really it is where a river opens into the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal river mouth is where the river opens out to meet the sea.

clue.text: Assumes control and comes on to bowl

definitions.meaning: to seize the reins of a company or country
in cricket a new bowler replaces the previous one at an end

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the bowling alternates between bowlers; one who comes on to bowl replaces another.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean replacing someone in charge, of a firm or of the bowling.

clue.text: Prayer Italian omitted in brief opening

indicators.note: omitted says those letters are left out of the longer word

parts.note: an introit is the prayer or psalm said at the start of Mass

explanation.surface: A short service where the Italian prayer is dropped at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing IT from INTROIT leaves INTRO.
explanation.definitionFit: A short preface or introductory passage is a shortened word for an introduction.

clue.text: Wine in the Spanish clubs variable according to demand

indicators.note: in places the wine inside the other letters

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
C is the card-game abbreviation for clubs
Asti is a sparkling Italian wine

explanation.surface: Wine served in Spanish clubs, its price rising and falling with demand.
explanation.definitionFit: Economists call demand that shifts with price flexible, stretchy in the economic sense.

clue.text: For instance, goose's beginning

parts.note: e.g. abbreviates exempli gratia, for example

indicators.note: beginning takes just the opening letter of the bird's word

explanation.surface: A remark on how a goose's life starts.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines: every gosling begins life in a shell.
explanation.definitionFit: A goose starts life as a shelled ovum laid by its mother.

clue.text: Got round English with strange riddle

indicators.note: strange tells us the letters of the next word are oddly arranged

explanation.surface: Someone solved a peculiar English puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: To girdle something is to encircle it, so this verb means went around.

clue.text: Aggressive action leading to widespread complaints

definitions.text: Aggressive action leading to widespread complaints

parts.words: Aggressive action leading to widespread complaints
parts.note: complaints are illnesses here, deliberately spread among an enemy as a military tactic

explanation.definitionFit: Biological attack uses disease-causing organisms as weapons against an enemy population.

clue.text: One wanted to appear in this sort of picture

definitions.text: One wanted to appear in this sort of picture

parts.words: One wanted to appear in this sort of picture
parts.note: 'wanted' reads as desired but means sought by police, and the picture is a composite face built from witness descriptions

explanation.definitionFit: A police composite of a suspect's face is assembled from standard features.

clue.text: Passion obvious in retrospective work

annotationWithheld.why: Passion obvious in retrospective work (5), answer ANGER: printed as scanned, but no parse of 'obvious in retrospective work' gives ANGER

clue.text: Charms listeners on purpose

indicators.note: on puts the listeners after the purpose in the across answer

parts.note: an end is an aim or purpose
ears are what we listen with

explanation.surface: A speaker deliberately charms the audience.
explanation.definitionFit: To win affection is the verb sense: makes someone fond, wins hearts.

clue.text: Improvise without rate increase

parts.note: ex is Latin for out of, without
tempo is the rate or speed of music
a rise is an increase

explanation.surface: A jazz musician plays freely without speeding up.
explanation.definitionFit: To ad-lib is to speak or perform without preparation.

clue.text: Get too big for old hat to stretch

parts.note: something old hat is out of fashion, out
to grow is to stretch or lengthen

explanation.surface: An ancient hat has to be stretched for a growing head.
explanation.definitionFit: Children become too large for their clothes as they get bigger.

clue.text: Present a radio programme

definitions.meaning: the BBC Radio 4 morning news show of that name

explanation.walkthrough: Today is BBC Radio 4's flagship morning news programme.
explanation.definitionFit: The present day is this very day, and the BBC news show bears the same name.

clue.text: Butcher trims duck or chicken joint

indicators.note: to butcher is to hack up or mangle, so the letters are cut up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A butcher prepares duck or chicken pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butcher' is a verb here, rearranging TRIMS DUCK.
explanation.definitionFit: The lower leg of a fowl is the cooked leg piece served from a chicken.

clue.text: Rich value in new make of car, say

indicators.note: remade into a new form, so the letters are rebuilt in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A new car model offers rich value.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things relating to motor transport, such as a car.

clue.text: Pinned in by bishop. Scot chucked the game

indicators.note: pinned inside the following words, the letters are held within them

explanation.surface: A chess scene: a piece pinned by a bishop and a Scot throws the game.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across bisHOP SCOT CHucked.
explanation.definitionFit: A children's playground pastime of hopping between chalked squares.

clue.text: Some part, possibly, out of posh play

indicators.note: possibly says the letters might be arranged some other way

parts.note: U denotes upper-class, posh

explanation.surface: An actor takes a small role, perhaps, in an upper-class drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges SOME PART and U (upper-class, posh). Agatha Christie's long-running London play is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Agatha Christie's murder mystery is the longest-running stage production in London.

clue.text: Slip on another one?

parts.note: a slip here is both a mistake and a slip of paper pasted into a book listing an earlier mistake

explanation.definitionFit: A printed correction notes an error in a book, often on a separate slip.

clue.text: They support speakers backing help to work

indicators.note: backing turns the run of letters round to read in reverse

parts.note: aid is help
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Loudspeaker stands are backed to help them function.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses the whole run, not just one piece; 'speakers' suggests loudspeakers but means orators.
explanation.definitionFit: Raised platforms hold up orators as they address an audience.

clue.text: Shakespearean heroine's pride at being transformed

indicators.note: being transformed signals that the letters are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A heroine of Shakespeare takes pride in a transformation.
explanation.definitionFit: The lost princess of The Winter's Tale is a leading female character in the play.

clue.text: Keep watch

definitions.meaning: to keep a rule or festival is to honour it
to watch is to look on attentively

explanation.definitionFit: One verb means both honour a custom and look at closely.

clue.text: Anxious to get half-hearted West Indian music over

indicators.note: over says the remaining letters are turned back to front
half-hearted removes half of the central pair of letters

parts.note: reggae is Jamaican popular music

explanation.surface: Someone keen to finish a lacklustre reggae set.
explanation.walkthrough: REGGAE's heart is GG; losing half of it leaves REGAE, which 'over' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen and impatient for something are both senses of being anxious to do it.

clue.text: Be affected emotionally about horse going for slaughter

indicators.note: about wraps the first word's letters round the horse

parts.note: to care is to feel concern, to be emotionally moved
a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: Someone grieves for a horse sent to the knacker's.
explanation.definitionFit: Mass killing is butchery on a large scale.

clue.text: Sort of cake for Tess's husband

definitions.meaning: a light sponge baked from egg whites
... Clare marries Tess in Hardy's Tess of the d'Urbervilles

explanation.walkthrough: In Hardy's novel Tess of the d'Urbervilles, Tess marries Angel Clare.
explanation.definitionFit: A light white sponge shares its name with Hardy's hero Clare.

clue.text: I finish off a letter about one fool

indicators.note: about wraps the dot round the single letter

parts.note: a small i or j is finished by adding its dot
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone completing a letter muses about a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A simpleton or dolt is a stupid person.

clue.text: Older mounting

definitions.meaning: climbing aboard a horse or bus

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means ageing and also climbing aboard.

clue.text: What would make women sign immediately?

annotationWithheld.why: What would make women sign immediately? (3), answer NOW: the wordplay is the instruction NO W (dropping W turns WOMEN into OMEN, a sign); the reverse form is refused as a whole-phrase reading and a cd would lose the mechanism
annotationWithheld.clue: What would make women sign immediately?

clue.text: Naval rating heading off tug suddenly

indicators.note: heading off removes the first letter

parts.note: to jerk is to tug sharply

explanation.surface: A sailor at the head of a tug lurches forward suddenly.
explanation.definitionFit: Service slang for a low-ranking seaman or aircraftman.

clue.text: Sweet maiden in Slough getting grant

parts.note: a slough is a bog or marsh
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
to allow is to grant permission

explanation.surface: A young woman in the Berkshire town of Slough gets a grant.
explanation.walkthrough: Slough is a Berkshire town, but here it means a bog. M (maiden, a scoreless over in cricket) follows MARSH.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft spongy confection is a kind of sweet.
